title: Unnecessary None check
detail: The added `elif fp is None:` guard is redundant because the preceding `elif isinstance(fp, _SupportsRead)` already covers non‑None values. It does not introduce a bug but adds noise to the logic.

title: Hidden options may be suggested
detail: The updated `get_path_completion_type` no longer checks `opt.help == optparse.SUPPRESS_HELP`. Hidden options that declare a path metavar will now be considered for completion, exposing option names that should remain hidden. This can leak internal option names and affect user experience.

title: Prevent split on None metavar
detail: Guard against `opt.metavar` being `None` before splitting. This prevents a `TypeError` when an option has no metavar, which can happen for hidden or non-path options. (PR-Agent's score: 7 of 10)
